subject: Importer, 0004, app_config API and admin seed job on shared (04634fd); local seed = expected counts, re-run 0 changes
body: Done: TipTap schema + converter (46a1dca), seed library/CLI, SVG sanitiser (camelCase, dup xmlns, allowlist), migration 0004, AppConfigService + /api/config/public + admin config API with history/409/NOTIFY, admin seed job (seed_runs), live_check --seed, runbook.
